english.title: Provide early years provision without being registered

date and location

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies from the 31st October 2024 due to changes made by the Levelling-up and Regeneration Act 2023. For the offence applying before this date, see H8672.
(ii) Section 34(2) of the Childcare Act 2006 provides certain exceptions to the requirement to be registered concerning schools.
(iii) Other exceptions may be provided by order by the Secretary of State, section 34(3) of the Act.

other.penalty:
Summary: a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecution:
Six months from the date on which evidence sufficient in the opinion of the prosecutor to warrant the proceedings comes to his knowledge, but no more than three years after the commission of the offence.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
